question: Should subagent-backed CLI rows adopt this cancellation-time reconciliation independently of the broader maintenance reconciliation in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90505?
rationale: The implementation appears correct, but cancellation and maintenance become separate writers of closely related durable task/session terminal state, so their permanent ownership and precedence need an explicit area-owner decision.

options.title: Land independently after rebase
options.body: Accept the narrow operator cancellation fix now after refreshing it against current main and confirming the maintenance proposal preserves the same terminal precedence.

options.title: Coordinate both state changes
options.body: Review and stage this PR with the maintenance reconciliation proposal as one session-state design before landing either change.

options.title: Consolidate into one branch
options.body: Move the useful cancellation cases into the canonical maintenance branch if maintainers want one implementation owner for all killed-subagent reconciliation.

recommendation.title: Land independently after rebase
recommendation.body: Accept the narrow operator cancellation fix now after refreshing it against current main and confirming the maintenance proposal preserves the same terminal precedence.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest merged-history signal is sustained ownership of task-registry lifecycle, persistence, control-runtime, and TaskFlow integration changes.
